name: aqg-automation-audit
description: Inventory automation stack (hooks / MCP / plugins / skills / env) + overlap-check vs AQG workflow + emit structured verdict in any host. Use PROACTIVELY when installing or updating a plugin / marketplace, suspecting a hook is interfering with AQG flow, seeing repeated system-reminder injections (typical noise signal), running monthly automation hygiene, OR before evidence-closeout if the automation stack changed mid-session. Advisory + read-only — it inventories and emits verdicts (keep / migrate / disable / fix); the human applies any change — this skill never modifies hooks, plugins, MCP, or skills. Defaults to current host (`~/.claude`) and supports `--skill-root` override.

sentence_patterns: Audit my automation stack — what hooks/MCP/plugins are live and which overlap AQG?
刚装了新 plugin, 检查是不是撞了 AQG 工作流
更新某个 plugin 后跑一遍 automation audit
看到反复出现的 system-reminder 注入, 帮我找哪个 hook

cli_contract.0: success — inventory captured (or overlap check completed)
cli_contract.1: reserved — surfaces missing pieces in output, does not raise
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args
cli_contract.3: config or schema error — settings.json or inventory.json malformed

owner_only_actions: Production / deploy / restart / credential rotation / raw private data / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates
Owner-only 5 items (business direction / strategy / taste / tacit knowledge / cross-long-term + irreversible actions) — escalate, never decide
Advisory only — this skill emits verdicts but never modifies hooks, plugins, MCP configs, or skills directories; the human applies any change

cases.prompt: Just installed the semgrep plugin — run an automation audit to see if it collides with the workflow
Inventory all hooks / MCP / plugins / skills + check overlap vs AQG workflow
I keep seeing system-reminder injections — help me find which hook is polluting the context
After updating a plugin, run an automation hygiene pass + verdict table
Please use the /aqg-automation-audit skill to produce inventory + overlap + verdict
